# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.x     | Yes       |
| 0.x     | No        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

QuantumSeal is a text scanner. It does not run cryptography and should never
receive secrets. If you find a security issue - for example a path traversal in
the scanner, a crash on hostile input, or a report that leaks file contents -
please report it privately with GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" button on the
Security tab.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 72 hours and to ship a fix or mitigation in
the next patch release. Please do not open a public issue before a fix is
available.
